subject: SI gating exception & marketplace listing coordination
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@si-core.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Kyle Smith <kyle.smith@si-core.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary entitlement bypass for pre-sales lab (SiCore)

Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We dug in with our engineering team and have a fairly tight pre-sales cadence for a large retail customer that requires a sandbox environment before final procurement. Two asks we need your help on: 

1) Marketplace entitlement gating currently blocks our sandbox users from exercising certain endpoints (embedding + reranking) — we need a short-term exception so we can validate the integration with our customer's data flows.
2) We also need a way to list the package in the marketplace as "pending entitlement" so procurement can see the listing while the entitlement mapping is completed.

Can Redwood provide a limited-time bypass (30 days) scoped to our sandbox project and a checklist of what you need from our side to approve this? Attached is a short integration_requirements.pdf that outlines the sandbox flows.

Timeline: customer pilot start: 2026-10-10; ideally exception approved by 2026-09-30 so we can complete validation.

Happy to hop on a quick call — Kyle and I are available tomorrow afternoon PT.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of Integrations | SiCore Technologies
attachment: integration_requirements.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@si-core.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary entitlement bypass for pre-sales lab (SiCore)

Daniel —

Appreciate the clear ask and the doc. Summarizing to make sure we’re aligned and to pull internal owners into the loop:

- Scope: temporary bypass for marketplace entitlement checks limited to a SiCore-managed sandbox project (30 days). No changes to production entitlements.
- Purpose: allow embedding + reranking endpoints to be exercised by pilot customer.
- Deadline: exception must be in place by 2026-09-30 to hit your pilot target.

Karthik / Irene — can product/security confirm feasibility and list the hard blockers? Specifically:
  * Audit impact (SOC2 / audit trail requirements) — what logs/controls do you need to approve a temporary bypass?
  * Implementation path — feature-flag at routing layer vs. entitlement-service rule exception (which one is faster/safer?).
  * Any billing/entitlement implications for Marketplace listing — can we display a "pending entitlement" status? Any UI/metadata constraints?

Action items I’m proposing:
  1) Karthik: quick call with engineering + security today to scope work and surface blockers.
  2) Irene: produce the minimal evidence we must capture to keep this compliant (logs, audit entry template).
  3) Ben (me): draft a Marketplace MOU and the short MA-template-draft.docx for legal to sign; attaching draft to this thread.

Daniel — can you confirm the exact sandbox project ID and a contact for your SRE so we can scope the routing rule? Also, please upload any customer-facing compliance forms you expect us to sign.

I’ll follow up after Karthik and Irene weigh in.

Best,
Ben Carter
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
attachment: MA-template-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@si-core.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary entitlement bypass for pre-sales lab (SiCore)

Ben / Daniel —

Quick product/secure readout after internal sync this morning. High-level: doable, but a few tradeoffs and guardrails we must enforce.

Technical options (with estimated effort):
- Option A (fastest, lower risk to platform): routing-layer rule that short-circuits entitlement check for requests carrying a one-time sandbox token scoped to SiCore sandbox project. Effort: ~1 day to implement rule + 0.5 day to add token issuance UI. Audit/trail: logs at gateway level; we can emit an "entitlement_override" event for every request.
- Option B (deeper, persists mapping): add a temporary mapping in entitlement-service for the sandbox project. Effort: ~3-5 days, more invasive, includes kv-store changes and extra QA. Produces the cleanest long-term state.

Security/Compliance ask (Irene): before we enable Option A we need:
  - Signed MOU that limits scope to non-production and confirms data handling constraints.
  - Gateway logs retained for 180 days and a daily digest that will be pulled into our security trace for the pilot window.
  - A named SRE contact from SiCore and emergency rollback SLA (we’ll auto-revoke the override at any sign of anomalous traffic).

Marketplace UX: Legal can accept a Marketplace listing with a "Pending entitlements" flag; ops will need a marketplace metadata field (string) and a small UI note. That’s low effort (1 sprint for the UI component, but we can do a manual listing update for the short-term).

Proposed next steps / owners: 
  - Ben: finalize MOU and route to Legal (I saw the MA-template-draft.docx attached).
  - Irene: publish minimal audit template to the drive link and confirm log retention changes.
  - Engineering (me): if Ben & Legal approve, we’ll implement Option A as an emergency path and add the override audit event. Schedule target: complete dev + canary by 2026-09-28.

Risks: any production traffic accidentally routed through the override; we mitigate with token scoping + canary and immediate revocation endpoint.

Irene, Ben: if you’re ok, I’ll block time for 9/22 to do the canary with SiCore SRE.

--
Karthik Iyer
VP Product | Redwood Inference

Ben / Karthik / Irene —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and clear options. We can accept Option A (routing-layer override) with the safeguards you described.

Actions from our side:
- I’m attaching a signed SOW-lite that confirms the sandbox scope and data handling limits.
- Kyle (cc) will be the named SRE and available for the 9/22 canary window; his email is kyle.smith@si-core.com.
- Sandbox project ID: sicore-pilot-2026-10.

We agree to the 180-day gateway-log retention for the pilot and the emergency rollback SLA. Please route the MOU to our legal contact (legal@si-core.com) once you have a draft.

We’re available for the canary on 9/22 at 14:00 PT; Kyle will join.

Appreciate the quick coordination — looking forward to shipping this pilot fast.

Best,
Daniel
